name: zenweb
description: Production-grade Chrome Extension (Manifest V3) for ADHD & Autism Spectrum neurodivergent cognitive design and sensory regulation.

scripts.validate: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['manifest.json','background.js','content.js','ai-engine.js','game-engine.js','audio-engine.js','popup.js','sidepanel.js'].forEach(f => { if(f.endsWith('.json')) JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')); else new Function(fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8')); console.log('✓ ' + f); }); console.log('All files valid!');"
scripts.package: node -e "const fs=require('fs'), zlib=require('zlib'), {execSync}=require('child_process'); console.log('Packaging ZenWeb extension for Chrome Web Store...'); execSync('powershell Compress-Archive -Path manifest.json,background.js,content.js,ai-engine.js,game-engine.js,audio-engine.js,popup.html,popup.css,popup.js,sidepanel.html,sidepanel.css,sidepanel.js,styles.css,icons,demo.html,README.md -DestinationPath zenweb-extension.zip -Force'); console.log('Successfully created zenweb-extension.zip');"

author: Principal Browser Extension Architect
